title: Summary and review questions
competency: Bring together the ideas of Unit 3.

keywords.def: A system of government in which ultimate political power is in the hands of the people.
The process of building democracy and a democratic culture over time.

en.text: Democracy means rule of the people and began in Athens. It is exercised directly or through representatives. Liberal and social democracy differ on the economy. Procedural democracy looks at process, substantive at results. Democratization is a process that needs parties, media, public opinion and civil society.

screens.title: Summary
paras: Democracy comes from demos and kratos: "rule of the people". It began in Athens.
Democracy can be direct, or indirect through elected representatives. Indirect democracy is most common today.
Democratization is a process. Political parties, the media, public opinion and civil society all play a role.

screens.title: Glossary
table: Ultimate political power is in the hands of the people
Citizens have a direct role in political affairs
Elected representatives act for the voters
Individual rights and freedoms; limited government in the economy
Property and income are under social control
The actual practice and outcomes of government

screens.title: Key words
defs: The process of building democracy and a democratic culture over time.

pairs: Citizens vote directly on one question
screens.why: Each term matches one idea from the unit.

screens.text: Which statement about democracy is true?
opts: Democracy and democratization is a process
Democracy is built by the government only
Direct democracy is more common today than before
screens.ans: Democracy and democratization is a process
screens.why: Building democracy takes time and many actors.
screens.clue: Is democracy built in one day?

screens.text: Political parties, the media, public opinion and civil society all play a role in democratization.
screens.clue: Read the last sentence of the summary.

screens.text: A town holds free elections, the council meets citizens monthly, and roads and schools improve. Which describes it best?
opts: Both procedural and substantive democracy work
screens.ans: Both procedural and substantive democracy work
screens.why: Free elections show the process works. Better roads and schools show results. Both views are satisfied.
screens.clue: Check the process and the results separately.

items.text: Democracy is thought to have originated in ancient Rome.
The substantive view of democracy focuses on what a government actually does.
There is no contribution from ancient Athenian democracy to modern democracy.
items.why: Athens was the foundation of modern democracy.

items.text: In a representative democracy, the people of a particular state have a direct say in political matters.
Through reform under the guise of capitalism, social democracy seeks to achieve equality and a classless society.
items.why: That is the goal of social democracy.

items.text: Which of the following actors is important in the process of democratization?
items.why: The summary names parties, media, public opinion and civil society.

items.text: Which of the following statements about ancient Athenian democracy is true?
opts: Citizenship was restricted to a small elite
Women and slaves were not allowed to participate
It was a direct form of democracy
items.why: All three are true of Athens.

items.text: What type of democracy is known for promoting a free-market system?
items.why: Liberal democracy is based on the free market.

items.text: Jarsuma as an indigenous governance system is being practised in:
items.why: Jarsuma is used by the Oromo people.

items.text: Which of the following statements about democracy is true?
opts: Democracy and democratization is a process
Democracy can be built by the participation of government only
Direct democracy is best known in our contemporary era than before
items.ans: Democracy and democratization is a process
items.why: Building democracy takes time and many actors.
